description: This file defines several filter classes for the Superset project, enabling filtering of resources by owners, users, roles, and related tables within the application.

classes.name: FilterRelatedOwners
classes.description: A filter class for searching resources by related owners, matching on first and last name or username.

classes.name: BaseFilterRelatedUsers
classes.description: A filter class for filtering related users, with support for excluding certain users based on configuration.

classes.name: BaseFilterRelatedRoles
classes.description: A filter class for filtering resources by related roles.

classes.name: FilterRelatedTables
classes.description: A filter class for searching related tables by table name.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Method implemented in each filter class to apply specific filtering logic to a SQLAlchemy query.
